site.name: THE INTELLIGENCE
site.subtitle: The official student newspaper for Years 7–9
site.heroTitle: A NEW YEAR. A NEW OPERATION.
site.heroText: Welcome to The Intelligence — a student newspaper designed to keep Years 7–9 informed, involved and curious about what is happening around campus.
site.alert: BREAKING: STUDENT LIFE IS NOW OFFICIALLY UNDER INVESTIGATION.

clubs.title: Basketball Club
clubs.text: Improve your game, compete and meet other students. Tuesdays after school.
clubs.details: Meet in the Sports Hall every Tuesday after school. Bring your PE kit and water.

clubs.title: Art & Design
clubs.text: Drawing, painting, design and creative projects. Beginners are welcome.
clubs.details: The creative department is open to anyone who wants to make something.

clubs.title: Science Club
clubs.text: Experiments, competitions and science beyond the normal classroom mission.
clubs.details: Experiments, challenges and science competitions. Ask your Science teacher for the next meeting time.

riddle.title: Riddle of the Week
riddle.question: I have keys but open no locks.\nI have space but no room.\nYou can enter, but you can't go inside.

entries.clue: History: The study of events from the past.
Music: A pattern of beats in a piece of music.
Art: A surface used for painting.
English: A system of words used to communicate.
Geography: A huge body of salt water.
Social studies: The study of money, resources and trade.
Science: The basic unit of life.
